content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I am committed to ensuring your experience with the products, services, technology and team at Averon Trust Bank is top notch. I look forward to hearing about the challenges your business faces, and share with you the many secure and efficient tools and resources available to you through Averon Trust in order to help better manage your business and your cash flow. 

A Little About Me

I spent my early years in banking in branches, and have worked in various roles in business banking over the last several years. My experiences have given me insight into the wants and needs of our customers.  

A few years ago, I was named a New Leader in Banking by the CBA and a 40 Under Forty honoree. I graduated from the Global School of Finance and Management, the American Bankers Association Stonier Graduate School of Banking, and the Chamber of Commerce of Eastern Global Leadership Program. 

I serve as a Board member for the Sprague, Franklin, Canterbury Little League. 

My wife and I have two sons. When not at work, I enjoy coaching my boys in baseball and basketball, and taking family camping trips.
